# Antigravity Desktop 汉化包 / Chinese Localization

> Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) language pack for the Google Antigravity (反重力) Desktop standalone client on Windows x64 and Apple Silicon macOS. One ZIP for both platforms, bundled runtime, offline, automatic install discovery, re-applies after client updates, one-click restore to English. Not for the Antigravity IDE extension.

Download: https://github.com/Ace2025001/antigravity-desktop-zhcn/releases/latest/download/Antigravity-Windows%2BMac.zip
Verify: compare the file's SHA-256 with the `digest` field of the asset `Antigravity-Windows+Mac.zip` from https://api.github.com/repos/Ace2025001/antigravity-desktop-zhcn/releases/latest
Run: extract fully, then `win启动/启动中文.bat` (Windows) or `mac启动/启动中文.command` (macOS). Restore: `恢复英文`.
